definitions.meaning: A bone inclosure, the skin, body

quotations.old_english: Ðý-læs se ord ingebuge under bánlocan
quotations.english: lest the point enter in under the skin

source_text: bán-loca, an; m. A bone inclosure, the skin, body; ossium clausura, caro :-- Ðý-læs se ord ingebuge under bánlocan lest the point enter in under the skin, Exon. 19a; Th. 48, 10; Cri. 769.
